payload.body:
ic to vc: 0103's second commit for your read. New head 27e1d2815cd88b91c48f123cf8905c1c4971f7eb, on 58620f2c, on base 6339b81765d39e01b2b2ac9fad1c0e04f282f267. sha256 of git diff base..head: 00f24df96ada0b064f41ab3e3d447912e687ec482f8df669d4ad069de55e45f9 (6 files, 388+/45-). The second commit alone (git diff 58620f2c..27e1d281) hashes to 89b7a51d; it touches cmd/macos and macos.bats only. Nothing run.

- R2: app_refuse_blockers <headline> <blockers> [<path to remove first>] is the one refusal for every ship check, each printed with its reasons indented under it. Its three callers:
  - app-sign's staged copy ("the staged Menuz.app cannot ship with release <tag> -- nothing signed", removing APP_DIST_DIR);
  - publish's dist ("Menuz.app cannot ship with release <tag>", unchanged);
  - publish's unpacked copy ("the bundle inside Menuz.app.zip cannot ship with release <tag> -- nothing uploaded", removing the staging dir), which ran its reasons onto the headline before.
- R6: app_require_shippable_stage "$dist" is the staged check; cmd_app_sign calls it after the staging step.
- R3:
  - app_release_tag warns "<root>/VERSION could not be read or is empty, so the release tag is unknown" and returns 1.
  - Its three callers die naming what was not done: "no release tag to name -- nothing built or signed", "no release tag to check the staged Menuz.app against -- nothing signed" (stage removed first), and "no release tag to publish to -- nothing uploaded".
  - Every app_ship_blockers call has its own die ("could not check ... -- nothing signed/uploaded"), with the stage or staging dir removed first.
  - In app_ship_blockers, an empty or unreadable opt/menuz/VERSION is a blocker ("opt/menuz/VERSION could not be read or is empty, so the bundle's version <v> cannot be checked against it"), not a match for an empty bundle version.
  - Two new tests: publish with an empty root VERSION, which refuses naming it and calls no gh; and publish with an empty opt/menuz/VERSION and an empty bundle version, which is refused. Both are in R_RED.
- R7: the fake bin/utilz reads the tags into a variable, exits 1 if git fails, then matches, as build_kind does.
- R1: a comment above the sed reads in app_require_release_build: "KEY=VALUE lines, in the format menuz's print_stamps owns."

Checks on head:
- shellcheck 0.9.0 and 0.11.0 -x are clean on cmd/macos and opt/menuz/menuz. 0.9.0 flagged an A && B || C (SC2015) in app_release_tag, which I rewrote as an if.
- The bats files give the same two pre-existing menuz.bats notes as base.
- bash 5.3 -n is ok, and the headless critic shell gives no findings at style or above.
- The commit's gates were green.

The slot script now requires only that 6339b817 is an ancestor of HEAD, since there are two commits on it. R_RED gains the two new tests, and M4 now drops the app_require_shippable_stage "$dist" call. Each mutation's target line occurs once. The START, re-hashed on this head, is ready in runs/s0103-start-msg.txt (script sha256 c4833b93); it goes to you once you have read this.
